_about: Privacy and safety switches: each sets one registry DWORD to its private (or safer) value; Healthy PC remembers the value it had and puts it back. Telemetry, ads, search, sync, AI and browser entries come from Kudu's Privacy Shield (MIT, Advent Development); the security ones are ours. Ours: level (how freely Tokkip says to protect it), needs (one step up when the PC has it) and loseEn (what you lose; Spanish in src/i18n/es.json).
